column1: # before: 6211b24 (in the prompt's pass, a position's key/value heads run in a parallel let); after: e0c785d (the heads one after another, and one copy of
# the positions a fork of the band product), measured before its source comment was corrected: the same emitted C. 2026-11-12, 18:42 to 18:56, an idle
# machine (started after five quiet minutes, mains power, the `performance` profile, nobody at it), Bend 2.0.40, bend-ml-tensor-array@0.1.20.0.
# gen <dir> <prompt> <new>, alternated shuffled rounds. new is 8; the last 30 rows have 1 (the weights, the 135M's 56 ids in one pass and one token).
# first_ms: the program's own clock from the start of the prompt to the first new token; ms_per_token_after: from the first new token to the eighth
# (the same code in both programs; on many threads it depends on what ran before it, so it is no control: NOTES, 2026-11-12). sys_s and
# voluntary_switches: the whole process's system time and voluntary context switches (its rusage). One thread is pinned (taskset -c 3) and counted
# by perf stat (cpu_core/instructions/u, cpu_core/cycles/u, the whole run). ids_bits: sha256 of the prompt ids, the generated ids and their logit bits.
